lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) proved helpful (+3.0% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests, while 3 showed no clear effect and 1 was stopped early.
Home redesigns (home, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow) were helpful (+4.2% average after noise correction), winning 1 test while 1 showed no clear effect.
Choose path redesigns (choose_path, redesign) were helpful (+2.9% average after noise correction), winning 1 test while 1 showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally too low for winning tests and consistently too high for tests showing no clear effect or performing poorly.

candidates.title: Interactive playstyle preference flow in adoption
candidates.change: Adds an interactive playstyle choice sub-flow screen where users set their desktop pet's activity level before completing the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 75.2% with a long mean duration (1017s). Interactive adoption sub-flows previously achieved +4.2% lift.

new_playstyle_picker.headline: Choose Your Pet's Playstyle
new_playstyle_picker.body: Select how active and talkative you want your desktop companion to be throughout the workday.

components.text: Quiet Companion, Playful Desktop Pal, Energetic Helper

guard.reason: Adding a playstyle choice sub-flow screen within onboarding is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Proven positive pattern (+4.2% avg) for adoption new_flow, though requires adding sub-flow screens.

candidates.title: Compact story screen redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the onboarding story intro into a compact layout with high-impact visual components.
candidates.why: The choose_path step takes a median of 8s but mean of 514s. Choose path redesigns previously showed a +2.9% average conversion lift.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience
story.body: Adopt, customize, and bring a living pet straight to your desktop workspace.

intro_story.text: Your pet lives alongside your open windows and keeps you company while you work.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Desktop overlay quick guide screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated visual guide screen right before finishing onboarding that demonstrates basic desktop controls.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and support received multiple queries regarding how to interact with or control the desktop pet after setup.

new_overlay_guide.headline: Interacting With Your Pet
new_overlay_guide.body: Drag to move your pet anywhere on your screen. Right-click to access pet actions and settings.

guard.reason: Adding a guide screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from finish drop-off and support, but adding new screens near finish previously reduced lift.

candidates.title: Photo submission confirmation step
candidates.change: Inserts a photo review screen allowing users to confirm custom photo uploads before triggering backend generation.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets about custom pet creation failing or producing unexpected results after photo upload.

new_photo_review.headline: Review Uploaded Pet Photos
new_photo_review.body: Ensure lighting is clear and your pet's face is centered for optimal desktop pet generation.

guard.reason: Adding a photo confirmation review screen within onboarding is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses custom pet support tickets, but extra review screen adds friction and evidence is thin.

candidates.title: Move sign-in after generation waiting step
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in step after pet generation waiting screen so users complete account creation right before entering home intro.
candidates.why: Sign-in reordering has proven consistently positive (+3.0% average lift) across tests by letting users experience pet creation before registering.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to after waiting is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High confidence backed by 7 prior tests (+3.0% avg), though reordering requires release effort.

candidates.title: Real-time generation progress indicators
candidates.change: Enables progress bar and estimated time remaining during the pet generation wait screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s; clear waiting updates reduce drop-off and perceived wait duration.

waiting.headline: Rendering Your Desktop Pet...
waiting.body: We are crafting your pet's 3D desktop assets and animations. This usually takes around 2 minutes.

guard.reason: Showing progress and time estimate for a real wait is permitted under Rules 4 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Targets extreme wait duration (2336s mean) with quick configuration/indicator toggle.

candidates.title: Desktop companion focus copy update
candidates.change: Updates headline and body copy on choose_path screen to highlight instant desktop companionship and lightweight app footprint.
candidates.why: Clear value messaging at choose_path helps set expectations early and boosts conversion from 80.6%.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Meet Your New Desktop Pet?
choose_path.body: Pick a quick starter pet to jump straight in, or upload photos to create a custom pet tailored to you.

guard.reason: Updated copy preserves the job of offering both adopting a starter pet and making a custom one.

candidates.score_note: Low cost text update for choose_path step, aligned with positive historical choose_path tweaks.

candidates.title: Account retrieval guidance hint on sign-in
candidates.change: Adds an explanatory hint on the sign-in screen guiding returning users to sign in with their existing account to retrieve saved pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again with a secondary or fresh account.

sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with your previous login method to restore existing pets and cloud saves.

guard.reason: Adding helpful account retrieval guidance text on sign-in is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence (8 emails) addressed via simple config text hint.

candidates.title: Starter item bundle showcase on home intro
candidates.change: Adds a starter item bundle highlight badge component to the home intro screen.
candidates.why: Finish completion is 64.8%; displaying unlocked starter rewards encourages users to complete the final onboarding step.

components.text: Includes Free Starter Pet Toys & Treats!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Free Starter Pet Toys & Treats!', violating Rule 3 which prohibits mentioning prices, discounts, gifts, or free extras.

candidates.title: Checklist layout redesign for photo upload screen
candidates.change: Changes the layout of the photo upload screen to a checklist style displaying key photo criteria.
candidates.why: Adoption completion is 75.2% and photo upload quality issues lead to support requests regarding custom pet appearance.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Follow the checklist below to ensure accurate 3D desktop pet generation.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen layout while preserving its functionality is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel and support point to photo quality issues; layout redesign on existing screen avoids extra steps.

decisions.title: Interactive playstyle preference flow in adoption

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) proved helpful (+3.0% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests, while 3 showed no clear effect and 1 was stopped early.
Home redesigns (home, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Choose path redesigns (choose_path, redesign) were helpful (+2.9% average after noise correction), winning 1 test while 1 showed no clear effect.
Adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow) showed mixed results (+0.9% average after noise correction), winning 1 test, showing no clear effect in 1, and performing poorly in 1.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally too low for winning tests and too high for tests showing no clear effect or performing poorly.
